messages.text: Your parcel could not be delivered. Please confirm your address and pay a €1.99 fee: paketblitz-delivery.test/x7

red_flags.hint: An ordinary mobile number: delivery services do not text from private numbers.
That is not the domain of the delivery service.
The small fee is the bait: they are after your card details, not €1.99.

explanation: One of the most common scam texts in Germany. Check your parcel directly in the carrier's app or website, never through the link in the text.

messages.text: Your online banking will be locked tomorrow. Renew your TAN app now: stadtbank-zwickau.account-check.test

red_flags.hint: What counts is the part before the ending: account-check.test. "stadtbank-zwickau" is only a subdomain.
A threat of being locked so that you click at once.
Sender names can be faked. The text can even land in the same thread as real messages.

explanation: Banks never send links to "renew" anything. If in doubt, open the banking app yourself or call the number on your card.

messages.text: Hi Mum, this is my new number. My phone is broken.
Can you please help me quickly? I have to transfer €1,340 today and my banking does not work on the new phone yet. I will pay you back tomorrow.

red_flags.hint: An unknown number claiming to be your child. Call the old number.
The new number explains why you do not see the name. That is how the scam begins.
Money, today, and an excuse why your child cannot do it themselves.

explanation: The "Hi Mum" scam. Always call back on the old, known number or ask a question only your child can answer.

messages.text: Hello, I am buying your sofa from Kleinmarkt. I will pay safely and send a courier.
To receive your money, enter your card details here: kleinmarkt-safe-pay.test/receive

red_flags.hint: Not the marketplace's domain, it only contains the word.
Nobody needs your card number and security code for you to RECEIVE money.
Buying unseen plus a courier: that is how it is moved off the platform.

explanation: Marketplace scam. Stay on the platform, hand things over in person if you can, never enter card details to receive money.

messages.text: You have 1 new voice message. To listen, install: mobilbox-voicemail.test/app.apk

red_flags.hint: An .apk is an Android app. It would be installed past the store's security checks.
You never install anything for a voice message. This kind of malware can read your texts and spread itself.

explanation: Malware by text: apps like this read your codes and send themselves to your contacts. Install apps only from the official store.

messages.text: Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow at 9:30. If you cannot make it, please call us. Your Dr Lang practice

explanation: Genuine: no link, no demand, an appointment you know about. For changes you call them yourself.

messages.text: Your sign-in code: 482913. You just started a sign-in. Never give this code to anyone.

explanation: Genuine: you just signed in yourself and the code even warns you. Only enter it on the page you are signing in to.

messages.text: Your order is at the Hauptstrasse 12 branch. Pickup code: 7741. Please bring ID.

explanation: Genuine: you are expecting a parcel, the message has no link and asks for no money. A pickup code and ID are normal.

messages.text: Stuck in traffic, I will be about 10 minutes late for the meeting. Feel free to start!

explanation: Genuine: a known contact, nothing asked of you, no link, no money.
